# `Q-18-17` — Reserved Chunk Option

> A knitr chunk sets the option `quarto-unit-id`, which Quarto reserves for
> its own use.

## What this means

When Quarto records what a document ran, it gives every knitr chunk an id by
adding a `quarto-unit-id` option line to the chunk. If the chunk already has
that option, knitr receives it twice and stops with `Duplicate map key`.
Quarto reports this error instead, and does not run the chunk.

## How to fix

Remove the `quarto-unit-id` line from the chunk's options:

````markdown
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| quarto-unit-id: abc123
1 + 1
```
````

Delete the `#| quarto-unit-id: abc123` line. Quarto picks the id itself.
